title: AI Browser Game Jam 5 results are in: 317 entries, a tie for 1st!
author: Slackluster
selftext:
Thanks to everyone who took part in AI Browser Game Jam 5! We had 317 entries over two weeks, and the quality this time was amazing. The image shows the top 10 games.

**Tied for 1st**

* [Coalheart](https://nebitula.itch.io/coalheart) by NeBITula: a little coal creature carries fire through a torch-lit temple where every ember counts.
* [Lightkeeper](https://thedannos.itch.io/lightkeeper) by TheDannos: guide ships home through a stormy night with your lighthouse beam.

**3rd**

* [CARRY THE LIGHT](https://atlas-house.itch.io/carry-the-light) by Atlas: park the rig, light the valley, and build a camp the dark won’t cross.

**Tied for 4th**

* [Last Flame: The Long Winter](https://jimmyjamstudio.itch.io/last-flame) by jimmyjamstudio
* [ZIGZAG DUNGEON](https://chipibaka.itch.io/zigzag-dungeon) by chipibaka
* [KENAZ - The Last Torch](https://erathul.itch.io/kenaz) by Erathul
* [Wicklight](https://mistercoconut.itch.io/wicklight) by Mr. Coconut
* [Torched!](https://erathul.itch.io/torched) by Erathul
* [Torchkeeper](https://colestartech.itch.io/torchkeeper) by ColeStar Tech
* [Black-Figure: The Stolen Flame](https://m040xie.itch.io/black-figure-the-stolen-flame) by m040xie

Full results: [https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-5/results](https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-5/results)

Congrats to everyone who shipped a game, and thanks to all who played and rated. We’ll be announcing one more jam soon to close out the year over the holidays, so stay tuned!
